s1-aisle: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight down the central aisle of a medieval English church during a storm, vaulted wooden ceiling at the top of frame, stone-flagged aisle floor at the bottom. Empty wooden pews on both sides. Far down the aisle, an enormous black dog stands in silhouette against a tall window lit white by lightning, its shape indistinct, its eyes faintly catching the light. No other figures. Photorealistic, dark, terrifying.
s2-church: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight at a Suffolk flint church with a square tower across a churchyard at night in a storm, boiling storm clouds at the top of frame, wet grass and leaning gravestones at the bottom. A fork of lightning behind the tower. No people. Photorealistic.
s3-door: Vertical portrait color photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight at a massive ancient oak church door of dark vertical timber planks with heavy black iron strap hinges, set in a pale weathered stone Gothic arch, with four deep black scorched claw gouges raking diagonally down the wood grain at chest height, their edges charred as if burned into the timber, in dim grey overcast daylight, muted natural color, the stone arch top at the top of frame, a worn stone step at the bottom. No people, no text, no lettering. Photorealistic.
s4-marsh: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight across a flat coastal marsh at dusk, heavy grey-violet sky at the top of frame, dark reeds and standing water at the bottom. In the middle distance, standing side-on in profile on a low grass bank, one enormous shaggy black dog like a giant wolfhound, long tail low, heavy muzzle and pricked ears turned toward the camera, black against the dim light, slightly blurred by dusk. It is unmistakably a huge dog. No people, no other animals. Photorealistic, cold, ominous.
s5-dig: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking down into a shallow archaeological trench beside ruined medieval abbey walls in overcast light, broken stone arches at the top of frame, excavated dark earth at the bottom. In the trench the long articulated skeleton of a very large dog lies half-uncovered in the soil, nose to tail. Small excavation tools beside it. No people, no text. Photorealistic.
s6-door-night: Vertical portrait color night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight at a massive ancient oak church door of dark vertical timber planks with heavy black iron strap hinges, set in a pale weathered stone Gothic arch, with four deep black scorched claw gouges raking diagonally down the wood grain at chest height, their edges charred as if burned into the timber, at night, close enough that the door fills the frame, the stone arch top at the top of frame, the worn stone step at the bottom, lit warmly from below by a single candle lantern standing on the step, deep shadows. No people, no text, no lettering. Photorealistic.
